fact: A dispatch failure or timeout should pause the workflow for the user with its last checkpoint, pending Work Turns, and already accepted results.
Recovery should continue the missing Work Turns from the preserved checkpoint and require a settled old call before retrying its Subagent.
A recovery Playbook should explain the failed operation, available evidence and continuation choices from the checkpoint before the user chooses how to proceed.
Later Designer versions should run with the same task inputs and model settings as the 0.1 baseline when comparing results.
